summary.title: Antoine Craske | Technology Executive & Independent Researcher on AI Transformation
summary.one_liner: A senior executive's research index on how AI agents change engineering production capacity and the constraints that limit it, with pointers to essays on architecture, operating models and quality engineering.
keywords: how ai changes software delivery capacity
verification and feedback loops in engineering
takeaways: AI agents change engineering production capacity and its constraints, not just individual coding speed.
Each productivity gain moves the bottleneck elsewhere (constraint migration), so the constraint must be re-found after each change.
The author reports moving La Redoute from quarterly releases to 40–80 deployments per day with under 10 minutes from commit to production.
The page frames six fields: AI engineering transformation, systemic CTO, enterprise architecture, data and AI, technology operating models, and quality engineering.
summary.summary: This is the landing page of Antoine Craske's independent research on AI-driven engineering transformation. It states a central thesis that AI agents change the production capacity and constraints of the whole technology system, not only developer speed. The page argues from the author's 15+ years of DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering and platform work, including a reported move at La Redoute to 40–80 deployments per day. It lists six research areas and links to a flagship publication, "The AI Engineering Production System," which is described as a frame with six stages and a workforce of agents and people.
